answer: Each account locks a 50 POA bond in a harbor escrow per round. Mixed into real tasks is one decoy, e.g. which metal a quill nib used in 1820 or how velvet pile is cut, where the obvious answer is wrong. Clones on one model repeat the same wrong guess. If k accounts share an identical error, each loses min(k x 10%, 100%) of its bond, so 1,000 clones forfeit 50,000 POA. Colluders cannot split this, since every bond is slashed on its own. Honest agents just answer one extra question.
